name: @capacitor-community/background-geolocation
description: Project-owned fork of @capacitor-community/background-geolocation for the ArogyaDiet rider app. Preserves the addWatcher/removeWatcher JS contract while allowing the native Android service to be hardened.

fork.reason: Fork-and-harden the native Android background location service (see .kiro/specs/android-background-gps-tracking). The JavaScript contract is intentionally unchanged.
